TcHmi.Controls.System.TcHmiRegion.ZoomMo.title: Zoom Mode
TcHmi.Controls.System.TcHmiRegion.ZoomMo.description: Controls whether the user can zoom/pan the region content. 'Off' disables it. 'Auto' keeps the zoom/pan gestures always active: a tap or click still reaches the content, and a drag pans the region unless the content control under the pointer claims the drag for itself. 'Toggle' adds a toolbox button switching between region zoom/pan and content interaction.

TcHmi.Controls.System.TcHmiRegion.PanBou.title: Pan Bounds
TcHmi.Controls.System.TcHmiRegion.PanBou.description: Controls how far the content can be panned. 'Free' allows moving the content out of the region. 'KeepContentInFrame' keeps the content inside the region: content larger than the region always covers it completely and content smaller than the region cannot be moved beyond its edges.

TcHmi.Controls.System.TcHmiRegion.Previe.title: Preview Visibility
TcHmi.Controls.System.TcHmiRegion.Previe.description: Controls when the minimap preview of the region is shown. 'WhenContentOverflows' shows it whenever the content does not fully fit the region (including while zoomed in).

TcHmi.Controls.System.TcHmiRegion.Previe.title: Preview Snapshot
TcHmi.Controls.System.TcHmiRegion.Previe.description: Controls whether the minimap preview renders a static content snapshot. 'No' shows only the visible section. 'Initial' creates the snapshot once after the configured snapshot time. 'Interval' additionally refreshes it at that rate and can have a performance impact.

TcHmi.Controls.System.TcHmiRegion.ZoomAn.title: Zoom and Pan
TcHmi.Controls.System.TcHmiRegion.ZoomAn.description: Configuration of the zoom feature of the region.

propertiesMeta.name: mode
propertiesMeta.description: Controls whether the content can be zoomed/panned: 'Off', 'Auto' or 'Toggle'. 'Off' disables it. 'Auto' keeps the zoom/pan gestures always active: a tap or click still reaches the content, and a drag pans the region unless the content control under the pointer claims the drag for itself (e.g. an editable slider). 'Toggle' adds a toolbox button switching between region zoom/pan and content interaction.

propertiesMeta.name: minZoomLevel
propertiesMeta.description: Minimum zoom level in percent the content can be zoomed to. Absolute like in the browser: 100 is the unzoomed size, 10 is a tenth of it. Only applied while zooming is active.

propertiesMeta.name: maxZoomLevel
propertiesMeta.description: Maximum zoom level in percent the content can be zoomed to. Absolute like in the browser: 100 is the unzoomed size, 1000 is ten times of it. Only applied while zooming is active.

propertiesMeta.name: initialZoomLevel
propertiesMeta.description: Initial zoom level in percent the content starts at. Absolute like in the browser: 100 is the unzoomed size. Clamped to the configured min/max zoom range. Only applied while zooming is active.

propertiesMeta.name: initialPositionX
propertiesMeta.description: Initial horizontal pan offset in pixels the content starts at. Only applied while zooming is active.

propertiesMeta.name: initialPositionY
propertiesMeta.description: Initial vertical pan offset in pixels the content starts at. Only applied while zooming is active.

propertiesMeta.name: panBounds
propertiesMeta.description: Controls how far the content can be panned: 'Free' allows moving the content out of the region, 'KeepContentInFrame' keeps it inside (content larger than the region always covers it completely, content smaller than the region cannot be moved beyond its edges). Only applied while zooming is active.

propertiesMeta.name: showZoomButtons
propertiesMeta.description: If set to 'true', the zoom in (+) and zoom out (-) buttons are shown. Only applied while zooming is active.

propertiesMeta.name: previewVisibility
propertiesMeta.description: Controls when the minimap preview is shown: 'Always', 'Never', 'OnlyWhenZoomedIn' or 'WhenContentOverflows' (whenever the content does not fully fit the region, including while zoomed in). Only applied while zooming is active.

propertiesMeta.name: previewSnapshot
propertiesMeta.description: Controls whether the minimap preview renders a static content snapshot: 'No' shows only the visible section, 'Initial' creates the snapshot once after the configured snapshot time and 'Interval' additionally refreshes it at that rate and can have a performance impact. Only applied while zooming is active.

propertiesMeta.name: snapshotTime
propertiesMeta.description: Time in milliseconds after which the static content snapshot is created. With Preview Snapshot set to 'Interval' the snapshot is additionally refreshed at this rate. Only applied when Preview Snapshot is 'Initial' or 'Interval'.
